newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-VETERAN BAGACH WINS SHOT PUT WORLD TITLE.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-VETERAN BAGACH WINS SHOT PUT WORLD TITLE.

text.p: Veteran Aleksandr Bagach of Ukraine won his first shot put world title after a tight battle with defending champion John Godina in Saturday's final.
American Godina, who was given a wild card to compete, was leading with a mark of 21.44 metres when the 30-year-old Bagach recorded 21.47 metres with his third attempt, sufficient to earn the gold.
Godina had to be content with silver while Oliver-Sven Buder of Germany took the bronze by beating his previous personal best mark with an effort of 21.24 metres at his final attempt.
Olympic champion and world record holder Randy Barnes failed to make the final after finishing 14th in the morning's qualifying rounds.
